audit_summary.previous_export_allowed_logic: validate_workbench_payload allowed export when blocked_fields was empty; all three formats shared _workbench_export_payload.
audit_summary.unresolved_master_behavior: Auto-fill returned resolved_masters and unresolved_masters; validation separately required header and row ERP IDs.
audit_summary.previous_confidence_behavior: Only req.fields objects below 0.5 generated warnings; confidence did not produce a quality score.
audit_summary.frontend_behavior: Validation and export errors were shown in the existing review panel, but no backend quality score or explicit preflight call existed.
audit_summary.export_behavior: JSON, Excel, and PDF already used one validation helper and returned streaming responses only after validation.

frontend_review_gate_behavior.blocked: Export buttons remain visible and are disabled after a blocked precheck.
frontend_review_gate_behavior.review_required: Export remains enabled with a visible warning.
frontend_review_gate_behavior.ready: Grade A exports directly after precheck.

export_endpoint_gate_behavior: All JSON, Excel, and PDF exports run the same export precheck after legacy normalization and return HTTP 422 with score, blockers, missing fields, and unresolved masters when blocked.
risks: The legacy /workbench/validate response remains backward-compatible and can be less strict than the export precheck.
ERP product IDs are required for sales and purchase exports.
Unrecognized date formats are treated as suspicious and require correction.
Optional low-confidence values trigger review but do not independently block export.
